name: tg-rental-withholding
description: Prepare a Togo gross-rent withholding or owner-advance working paper for 2026 using the read LPF collection provisions. Use this Guide to identify the tenant category responsible for withholding, separate gross rent from the landlord's cash receipt, calculate the property-tax and income-tax credit components, select the owner-payment route when rent does not undergo withholding, and retain remittance evidence for later assessment. Two executable cases reconcile a monthly corporate tenant's payment and the different responsibilities for a business tenant versus an ordinary private tenant. This is a collection job, not a final rental-income or annual property-tax assessment. Current forms, credit-excess procedures, disputed noncompliance and later-law continuity remain explicit holds.
